notes.title: Update 2.0.1.2 23.10.2024
notes.content:
New Update Announcement!

We’re thrilled to unveil a new update packed with exciting content, new characters, and game improvements! Here’s what you can expect:

🗺️ Explore Haltona Island:


 A brand new island has arrived, along with the town of Crawcan.
 Take to the skies and fly to Haltona Island, where you’ll discover new adventures and challenges.
 Haltona is now fully populated and ready for exploration!


🏠 Crawcan City Additions:


 Meet Mydona, the new town leader of Crawcan, and embark on quests to uncover the island's secrets.
 Discover a new house with flavor text that delves deeper into the island’s lore.
 Encounter the Cursed Fairies who have fallen to the Slime Emperor’s curse. You can turn them back to normal if you're the Slime Emperor!


⚔️ New Weapons and Characters:


 Obtain the powerful Green Rod by completing quests from Mydona.
 Check out new weapons including the Plastic Death's Scythe, Skeleton Mace, and Dubious Potion.
 Meet Kera Kera, a frog character who offers special items during Halloween in the Warrior's Sib! Available only until November 4th!

⚽ Football Field Mechanic:


 Head to Crawcan and find the football field, where you can play and score 5 goals or defeat 5 Skeleton Spiders to earn your way out!
 A new monster, the Skeleton Spider, lurks on the field. Defeat it to earn rewards!


🎶 New Music and Visuals:


 Enjoy the new background music, Kondra, in Crawcan City.
 Freshen up your adventure with new sprites for walls and flowers and doubled tree sizes on Kapra Island!


⚙️ Quality of Life Improvements:


 Full-screen option is now available in the menu.
 No more EXP for Reserve Members – only active fighters get the gains!
 Various bug fixes, including the removal of the buggy Magic College video.
 Prepare your best adventuring gear and dive into this exciting update full of new stories, characters, and battles!


Available now!

notes.title: Update 1.9.8.2
notes.content:
Hey everyone,

We've got some fresh updates coming your way, and we can't wait to share what we've been cooking up!

Here's the lowdown on what's new:


 Say goodbye to the pesky Underwater Temple exit bug. It's been dealt with!
 Ready to explore? Patagania Island is now on the map.
 Get ready to uncover the mysteries of Lower and Upper Murdford, two eerie dead forests filled with skeletons and a brand new quest waiting to be unraveled.
 Ever heard of the Tunnel? Well, now it's your chance to explore it! Keep an eye out for the entrance near Ikduman-Sil, especially if you've misplaced your eye.
 Got a dragon? Then you're in luck! Fly over to Upper Mudford for some aerial adventures.
 Welcome to Mudford, folks! A new addition to our ever-expanding world.
 Groove to the beats of our latest BGM, Moglish, as you navigate through these new lands.
 Don't miss the new slab waiting for translation in Mudford. Who knows what secrets it holds?
 Down in Lower Mudford, you'll meet Jijan. Give him a skull, and he'll reward you with a nifty +500 HP boost.
 So grab your gear, rally your party, and get ready to dive headfirst into these exciting new updates!
 

See you in the game!

notes.title: Update 28.01.2024
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44682700/e50d4c2d1e9308a99532c633920797642eb6359f.png
🌟 Unveil the Power of the Slime Emperor: Conquer new realms and recruit Grog to your party as you ascend to the prestigious title of Slime Emperor.

💼 Armory Expansion: Increase your weapon capacity to a whopping 999, ensuring you're prepared for every battle that comes your way.

👥 Meet New Allies: Encounter intriguing characters like Slime and Skeleton, each offering unique abilities to aid you on your journey. You can now craft a Monster Catcher that you can use during your battles against Slimes and Skeletons.

🖼️ Enhanced Visuals: Immerse yourself in refreshed tilesets and elevated game aesthetics, making every moment of gameplay visually captivating.

🔧 Bug Fixes and Improvements: Enjoy a smoother gaming experience with resolved bugs in Algaria Forest, the wilderness, and the Underwater Temple.

🔍 Unravel the Origins: Embark on the captivating Kephalonia arc, exploring the origins of The Slime Emperor from Kapra Island. You can now use the big demon statue on Kapra Island if you are the Slime Emperor and have the Demon Goat with you.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44682700/8fa6a5bbb90f0b9b95f96de529b5f94ebb114049.png
🎁 Limited-Time Offer Ended: Bob the Holiday Snail-Crab, available exclusively during the festive winter season, has unfortunately left the Warrior's Sib. But he will return soon enough during the next festive season.

Update your game now and embark on an unforgettable adventure filled with excitement, discovery, and endless possibilities! 🚀✨ #GameUpdate

notes.title: Update 1.9.4.6
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44682700/f0b5cbf592ffcd58dab0f7d43f3ce47ddaeb2e86.png
Ahoy, Adventurers! Update Alert 🚀🌊

We're thrilled to announce a monumental update to The No-Name Project, packed with exciting features and enhancements to make your gaming experience even more thrilling. Let's dive into the details of what's changed:

Quest Improvements:

Quest givers now sport a helpful Quest balloon, making it easier for you to identify them and embark on your next adventure.

Visual Enhancements:
Experience the magic with new map flavor effects, including mist and other captivating map visuals.

Bug Fixes:
Money troubles no more! We've fixed a pesky bug where no money was being deducted during house upgrades.
The magic college video is now playing as intended.
Tulsa and Kolon prison text triggers have been fixed, ensuring a smoother storyline progression.

Gameplay Tweaks:
The coal vein is now more visible, making resource gathering a breeze.
Experience the progress of each training in the Magic College after each session.
Magic Training requirements have been lowered from 100 to 25, allowing you to master magical arts sooner.
Various text fixes and adjustments for a more immersive gameplay experience.

Balancing and Adjustments:

Lowered the Blozen-bush drop rate to 1/5.
Skillpoint requirements to learn Heal have been lowered to 25.
The speed of half of the Ice Spirits has been reduced for better gameplay balance.

Seafaring Adventures:
Introducing a brand new Boat Creation System! Build your own boat with 10 logs at the Port of Algaria Island.
Sail through the ranks with Boat Classes, starting from E and reaching all the way up to S (yes, that stands for spaceship).
Seagulls now grace the ports, adding a touch of realism to your maritime endeavors.
A new BGM, BoatAhoy, accompanies you on your boat adventures.

New Enemies and Items:
Face off against the Sea Monster, a formidable new enemy.
Discover the Chaos Fish (item 207) dropped by the Sea Monster, now available for collection.

Ship Upgrades and Events:
Upgrades for boats from Class E to S, each class offering unique events and challenges.
New achievements to unlock as you progress through shipbuilding.
Encounter Pirates, Sea Slugs, and more in Class D boat events.

Island Expansions:
Randalf Island makes its debut, featuring adorable Tanukis and new events.
Uncover secrets in Kapra Tower, now free from bugs.

Interiors and Transformations:
Personalize your crew with new skins.
Introducing Transformation Dust (item 208) – transform your crew into something entirely new.

Space Adventures:
Explore the final frontier with Class S boat events, featuring asteroids, space tentacles, and more.
Face off against the formidable Space Tentacles in your space-faring adventures.

Resurrection and More:
Learn about Abriz, and if you discover her fate, you now have the power to resurrect her in her house.
This update is a testament to our commitment to providing you with a dynamic and ever-expanding gaming world. Set sail, face new challenges, and uncover the mysteries that await in The No-Name Project. As always, your feedback is invaluable, and we look forward to hearing about your adventures in this enhanced gaming experience!

⚓️ Happy gaming, adventurers! ⚓️

notes.title: Update 1.8.5.1 [04.11.2023]
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44682700/c55a40ecd9f8edd7e7c55d4844cc8ad6854b16c3.png
We're thrilled to introduce the latest update to The No-Name Project! This update brings several exciting changes and improvements to enhance your gaming experience. Here's a summary of what's new:

Gameplay Enhancements:


 Never miss out on an opportunity to communicate with our feathered friends – we've added chicken text for those who've mastered the art of speaking with animals.
 Unlock your inner necromancer! Events requiring necromancy to conquer both caves in Algaria will now appear only if you possess the necessary knowledge.
 Escape attempts from prison have become a lot trickier – you can no longer use homecoming or fly during the prison event in Hestos.

Bug Fixes and Quality of Life Updates:

 We've squashed some pesky text bugs that were lurking in the game.
 The Crafting screen can no longer be accessed while inside other screens, like the Achievements panel.
 Text issues related to the Slime Sword event have been addressed.
 You'll now experience the moon cycle event in the Manor.
 The bouquet icon for the Sad statue has been fixed.
 Your inn stay will now reward you with the correct amount of experience and gold.
 Orghoul of Alzaria and Adult Dragon will no longer mistakenly join your army.
 The Magic of College first visit bug has been resolved.
 Chop down trees with ease once you've reached 50 skill points in Tree-cutting.
 You can now add all your Slime balls at once at the hidden stone event in Algaria Forest.
 The Warrior's Sib Reward Items are no longer eligible for sale.

New Content and Features:

 We've expanded the world with the addition of Goldthera Island, complete with a special new background music (BGM) to set the mood.
 Fishing enthusiasts, rejoice! Goldthera now features fishing events for you to enjoy.
 Meet two new zombies on the island of Goldthera, Isman, and Deshau, and discover their stories.
 These new characters bring with them unique weapons and armor: Isman's Hands, Deshau's Hands, Isman's Legs, and Deshau's Legs.
 The Lone Tower on Goldthera Island offers new adventures.
 Unearth the Demon Heart and add it to your collection.
 Goldthera Island introduces two fresh faces, a Lich enemy, and Lovendale Quest 7.
 Seek out the Gold Sword, a hidden treasure on Goldthera Island.
 A new basement map in Goldthera awaits your exploration.
 The Lich has joined the ranks of our formidable adversaries.

Visual and Technical Improvements:


 Say hello to a new font – Ronysiswadi14-z82L3.
 We've fixed the intro video freeze bug.

Mystery Unveiled:
Keep your eyes open for a new secret event!

We hope these updates will make your journey through The No-Name Project even more enjoyable. Dive into the world of Goldthera Island, face new challenges, and discover the secrets hidden within. We value your feedback and look forward to hearing your thoughts on these exciting changes.

Enjoy your adventure, and stay tuned for more updates in the future!

notes.title: GAME 1.8.2.0
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44682700/a6a575bde4cac15e4900d2b01d2bc9cbb84d0f8d.png
Hey there!

We're absolutely stoked to share that our first Steam version, NNP V.1.8.2.0, is hitting the shelves on the 19th! You guys have been awesome, and we couldn't have done it without your support and patience.

Here's a taste of what's in store:


 Get your game on with a whopping 100 Steam achievements (even though we've got way more in-game!).
 We've spruced up the in-game text for a smoother ride.
 All those old events that were bugging you? Fixed, done, and dusted.
 For all the nitty-gritty details, check out the full scoop on NNP.MINDQUOTA.COM.


Here's the lowdown on the latest fixes and features:

 We've brought achievements to Steam, though we're keeping it to a cool 100 for now.
 The pesky STEAM OVERLAY bug is officially squashed.
 Psst... ever wondered what the chickens were saying? Well, wonder no more. We've got that covered now.
 Dive into some seriously spooky events with the necromancy skills in the Algaria caves.
 Oh, and watch out for that Crafting screen glitch during your achievements spree.


And that's not all! There's a moon cycle event waiting for you at the Manor, plus we've tidied up the bouquet icon for the Sad statue.

Get ready to buckle up for an epic ride with NNP V.1.8.2.0! Check out all the deets in our detailed changelog.

Thanks a bunch for sticking with us. Let's make this launch one for the books!

Catch you on the flip side, MindQuota.com.
